sinopsis.es: Es 1991, Ana María y Juan Manuel, una pareja de recién casados, reciben una criatura como regalo de bodas. ¿Lograrán cuidarla durante un año para preservar su matrimonio?.
sinopsis.en: It's 1991. Ana and Juan, a newlywed couple, receive a creature as a wedding gift. Amid the oppressive atmosphere of Juan's family, will they be able to care for it for a year to preserve their marriage?
